comparison.objective: Measure a training doll by straightening its sprung legs and closing a footboard; unlike tuning a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual restraint of compliant legs while positioning a measuring board; no fastener manipulation or repeated cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Leave the footboard at the length reading and release. The body omits numeric tolerances and scoring details; no spec versions are present.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant-body positioning and measurement, a meaningfully different ability.
